title: Personalized Baseball Bedding Full Size Flag Custom Name D - Design 21
description:
Transform your bedroom into a personalized haven with this unique Jeminise bedding set. Crafted for comfort and designed with a spirited baseball theme, this comforter set is perfect for baseball enthusiasts and makes a thoughtful, customizable gift for any occasion.

Key Features

  • Meaningful Gift: An ideal gift for baseball players, fans, and lovers, celebrating determination and passion for the sport.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88") to fit various bed dimensions.
  • Superior Manufacturing Process: Features environmental protection techniques that ensure vibrant colors resist fading for years to come, with smooth, fine, and compact stitching.
  • Soft & Cozy Feel: Made from 100% brushed polyester fabric, offering a soft, comfy, durable, and lightweight feel for a restful sleep.
  • Microfiber Filling: Contains whole-piece microfiber filling with tight stitching to prevent clumping or shifting.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water and can be air-dried without heat, allowing microfiber to dry quickly and become fluffier.
  • Personalized Design: Customize with up to two text inputs, making this bedding set uniquely yours.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter Set
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester, Cotton
Selected Design Baseball Thunder
Pattern Baseball
Included Components Duvet Cover
Customization 2 text inputs
Available Sizes US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), US King (104" x 88")
Special Feature Breathable
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine Wash
Thread Count 400
